name: EdgeConneX
verdict: Owned by EQT's infrastructure funds (largest shareholder since 2020; Sixth Street minority since 2024). EQT AB is listed in Stockholm; its largest disclosed shareholder is Investor AB at 14.0%. Nothing found.
note: OKGC pillar partner 2026 (KFOR via Yahoo Sports, 2026-04-21; logo in OKGC team page partner grid). Owned by the EQT Infrastructure IV and V funds; EQT AB (publ), their Stockholm-listed manager, publishes a top-25 shareholder table led by Investor AB (Wallenberg sphere) at 14.0% — no state owner in the chain, so nothing passes the METHOD.md test. Not recorded: EdgeConneX runs AdaniConneX, an Indian data-centre joint venture with Adani Enterprises (edgeconnex.com/company/about-edgeconnex); a JV partner is not an owner, so it cannot carry a rating.
